description: Synchronizes Claude skills from the skills repo (github.com/Theycallmeholla/skills) to the local ~/.claude/skills directory, ensuring local skills match the repo's latest versions. Compares each skill to detect new or changed content, creates a tarball for manual Claude app upload, and preserves local-only skills that aren't in the repo. Use when the user says "push skills out", "sync repo to local", "update my local skills from the repo", "distribute skills", "my local skills are stale", "refresh skills from github", or after pulling updates from the skills repo. Runs in dry-run mode by default to preview changes before applying them with --apply.
